source.data_source: Driver 1991 experimental Cp + Cf data files distributed by NASA TMR (Driver_validation/cp.exp.dat, cf.exp.dat). Original campaign: Driver, D. M. (1991). 'Reynolds Shear Stress Measurements in a Separated Boundary Layer Flow.' AIAA Paper 91-1787 (also NASA TM-102211).
source.extraction_method: separation_x_m and reattachment_x_m linearly interpolated from cf.exp.dat zero-crossings; cf_min_in_bubble is the most-negative tabulated point; cp_max_recovery is the maximum tabulated Cp.
source.physics: Axisymmetric APG separation downstream of a cylinder + diverging fairing. M=0.088 (effectively incompressible). The bubble is shallow (Cf reaches only ~-2e-4) and short (~0.15 m streamwise) — sensitive to turbulence-model curvature/APG response.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the axisymmetric mesh (single-wedge or 2D r-z plane)
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: TMR provides nested grids 113x65 (~7k) to 449x257 (~115k); a wall-resolved (y+~1) RANS of this geometry typically lands ~30-60k cells. Hand-set midpoint.

final_residual_U.description: Final residual of the momentum equation
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Hand-set; subsonic RANS on this geometry routinely reaches 1e-5 (steady SA). Some models (SST) may stall at 1e-4 quasi-steady.

separation_x_m.description: Streamwise location (in metres) where wall C_f first crosses zero from positive (separation point on the diverging fairing)
separation_x_m.T_good_source: Linearly interpolated from Driver 1991 cf.exp.dat between (x=0.0125, Cf=0.00011) and (x=0.1016, Cf=-0.00008): x_sep = 0.064 m. T_good = 0.025 m (~40%) covers the discrete-sample resolution (~0.05 m experimental spacing) plus turbulence-model spread (TMR SA predicts ~0.04, SST ~0.08, both within band).

reattachment_x_m.description: Streamwise location (in metres) where wall C_f crosses zero from negative back to positive (reattachment point)
reattachment_x_m.T_good_source: Linearly interpolated from Driver 1991 cf.exp.dat between (x=0.1524, Cf=-0.00017) and (x=0.254, Cf=0.00012): x_reatt = 0.212 m. T_good = 0.030 m covers experimental sample spacing + turbulence-model variation.

cf_min_in_bubble.description: Most-negative wall C_f anywhere inside the separation bubble (signed; expect negative)
cf_min_in_bubble.T_good_source: Driver 1991 cf.exp.dat at x=0.1524 m: Cf=-1.7e-4 (deepest tabulated negative point in the bubble). Experimental scatter at this magnitude is ~ +-0.5e-4. T_good = 1e-4 (~60% of |gt|) catches catastrophic miss but allows turbulence-model variation.

cp_max_recovery.description: Maximum wall Cp on the diverging fairing (peak pressure-recovery point), with Cp = 0 at the upstream reference station x = -0.457 m per Driver 1991 convention
cp_max_recovery.T_good_source: Driver 1991 cp.exp.dat: Cp_max = 0.593 at x = 0.457 m. T_good = 0.040 (~7% of gt) accommodates turbulence-model variation in pressure-recovery prediction; Cp peak is shaped by the streamline curvature plus shear-stress redistribution and is sensitive to APG closure.
